description: Offline ablation: extract pre-bottleneck 256-D representation from v2 ONNX weights (no retraining) and compare with PCA-projected 64-D, 128-D, and native 32-D outputs.

architecture_analysis.bottleneck_description: The transformer encoder output (batch×61×40=2440 flattened) passes through FC(2440→256)+ELU → FC(256→32)+ELU = 32-D embedding → FC(32→4) = 4 logits. The 256→32 projection is the bottleneck. The 256-D representation (val_303, post-ELU pre-FC32) is extracted directly from existing weights.

methodology.256d: Extracted intermediate 256-D tensor (val_303) from ONNX graph — pre-bottleneck representation
methodology.128d: PCA(256→128) applied to 256-D features, fit per-fold on training subjects only
methodology.64d: PCA(256→64) applied to 256-D features, fit per-fold on training subjects only
methodology.32d: Model's native supervised 32-D output (FC(256→32)+ELU) — unchanged production output
methodology.pca_bandpower: 110 band-power features (5 bands × 22 channels) → PCA(32), fit per-fold
methodology.protocol: LOSO (50 folds), train-only candidate pools, no self-retrieval, no leakage
methodology.preprocessing: 160→250 Hz resample, 22-ch BCI-IV-2a subset, bandpass 4-38 Hz, z-score per channel, 4s window (1000 samples)

bonferroni_correction.description: Bonferroni correction applied across 12 pairwise comparisons
